# webtables/continue

> `continue`: leaves the body block of the innermost loop, so its `next` block runs.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/continue.pkg) · translates [std/continue](../std/continue.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(br ${loop.L.next})
```
